messages:
ellie: Postmortem follow-up for the DNS+LB retry cascade. trying to keep this tight — owners, ETAs, blockers.

Summary: a transient registrar throttle + rapid route churn caused LB clients to retry aggressively, amplifying TLS handshake failures across regions. we need short-term mitigations + longer fixes to prevent recurrence.

Action items:
- A1) DNS registrar backoff: implement exponential backoff + rate-limit reconciliation attempts in controller (owner: rohan) ETA: 2026-03-31
- A2) LB handshake guard: add per-peer concurrent handshake cap + global soft-stop when amplification detected (owner: sam) ETA: 2026-03-29
- A3) Probe & alert: synthetic e2e that injects registrar 429s and measures downstream amplification (owner: ellie) ETA: 2026-03-27
- A4) Runbook + customer advisory: write mitigation steps (flush caches, temporarily reduce client retries) and a short customer-facing note for passthrough configs (owner: product@redwood) ETA: 2026-04-03
- A5) Telemetry: add histogram for handshake_retries_per_request and alert if p95 > 3 (owner: rohan) ETA: 2026-03-28

rohan: ack. for A1 i'll add a reconciler token bucket + per-host cooldown when registrar returns 429. will include unit tests and a migration to mark cool_down_ts.

sam: ack A2. plan: cap concurrent handshakes to 10 per-endpoint, add backoff with full jitter (base=30ms, cap=1.2s). also add a global circuit that if amplification_ratio > 2 for 1m we soft-stop cross-region retries.

ellie: ack A3. probe template: POST /internal/probe/registrar-429-sim -> {pair: "us-west-2:eu-central-1", concurrency: 30, rounds: 200} alert: amplification_ratio > 1.5. will add to nightly and tie to pager.

product@redwood: ack A4. drafting advisory recommending passthrough users limit client-side retries and enable keepalive pooling. will share draft by 2026-04-01.

infra-bot: Created ticket NET-5120 assigned to rohan,sam,ellie,product@redwood. First sync 2026-03-29 13:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: tag=registrar-backoff.v1 region=us-west-2 start_ts=2864001280. dashboard: /dashboards/dns-registrar-canary.

rohan: quick question - do we want registrar backoff behavior to be configurable per-cloud? some registrars differ in 429 semantics.

ellie: yes, make per-registrar policy defaulting to conservative backoff. add an override flag for edge cases.

sam: note: we'll also add a short-term runtime flag to reduce client retries globally while we roll fixes. i'll coordinate the canary playbook.

ellie: blockers: need access to registrar testbed for A3 — rohan can you grant?

rohan: done, testbed perms granted. i'll also seed synthetic 429s so probe can validate.

ellie: thanks. please update this thread when PRs are open or ETAs slip. if anyone can't meet ETA, call it out and we'll reassign. :thumbsup:
